sections.title: Contributors to population change in Richmondshire
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component, %

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Richmondshire, between 2025 and 2028:

  • More deaths than births meant that the population decreased by 2,058 people (−4.1%). In total, there were 3,801 births and 5,859 deaths in Richmondshire between 2025 and 2028.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in England) increased the population by 520 (1.0%). There were 34,478 people entering the area and 33,959 people leaving the area between 2025 and .
  • Net cross-border migration (between UK nations) led to a fall in the local population in Richmondshire of 1,630 people (−3.3%), as a result of 1,784 people entering the area and 3,414 people leaving the area between 2025 and 2028.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Richmondshire's population of 3,238 (6.5%).as a result of 5,637 people entering the area and 2,399 people leaving the area between 2025 and 2028.
